value.name: Dicky defends his boxing experience
value.description: Dicky angrily reminds Charlene that he fought Sugar Ray Leonard and questions what she has accomplished.
evidence: I was in the fuckin' ring with 'im, Chalene, don't you think I know what happened?
But I went ten rounds with Sugar Ray Leonard, what the fuck have you evah done?

value.name: Charlene admits life without Micky feels empty
value.description: Charlene says that her life without Micky sucks and that she loves him and wants him to have his chance.
evidence: Maybe, the part without Micky sucks.
Maybe I never did anything special like you, but I love Micky and I want him to have his chance.

value.name: Dicky and Charlene agree to stop fighting
value.description: Dicky tells Charlene to leave him alone and both agree to spare Micky from their bullshit.
evidence: He needs me, you heard him, and I know he needs you, so let's spare him the bullshit from either one of us.
OK. I'll see ya in Micky's corner, otherwise go fuck yourself.

value.name: Dicky leaves the porch
value.description: After the truce, Dicky walks off the porch.
evidence: Dicky nods, walks off the porch.

value.name: Micky arrives and sees Dicky leaving
value.description: Micky pulls up at Charlene's apartment building and notices Dicky leaving.
evidence: Micky slams the door of his car, walks to see: Dicky leaving.

value.name: Micky questions Dicky's visit
value.description: Surprised, Micky asks Dicky what he is doing there.
evidence: MICKY (SURPRISED) - What the hell are you doin' here?

value.name: Dicky says they worked it out for Micky
value.description: Dicky tells Micky that he and Charlene have resolved their conflict for Micky's sake.
evidence: We worked it out fah you. Ask her. It's all together.

value.name: Micky confirms the reconciliation
value.description: Micky looks to Charlene, sees her nod, and accepts that the situation is settled.
evidence: Micky looks up and sees Charlene standing in the door. She nods.
He looks at Dicky. MICKY Good.

value.name: Micky asks for O'Keefe to return
value.description: Micky tells Dicky to bring O'Keefe back as well, extending the reconciliation to his team.

value.name: Micky heads toward Charlene
value.description: After settling matters with Dicky, Micky moves toward Charlene.
